edits.value_json: 小 means “small.” Its present form is three strokes: a long central stroke between two shorter side strokes. Early marks are interpreted either as abstract signs of smallness or as fine sand grains, but their referent remains disputed.

小 means “small” and is written with a long central stroke between two shorter side strokes. The early marks are interpreted either as signs of smallness or as fine sand grains; their referent remains disputed.
